measurement.jitter: RMS of XYZ second differences multiplied by fps squared across every joint and interior frame
measurement.smoothing: three-tap binomial [0.25, 0.5, 0.25], with source-labelled contact intervals locking lfoot/rfoot horizontal XZ positions to the first contact sample
measurement.contactDrift: maximum horizontal XZ distance from each contact interval's first foot sample, across all frames and both feet
measurement.units: source position coordinates are metres; contact drift is reported in millimetres

clips.label: slow walk / stop
clips.contactLabelMethod: Intervals are present in the committed source JSON; method is not separately stated there.

clips.label: run / jog, sudden stop
clips.contactLabelMethod: Five-frame offline median plus measured source height/velocity hysteresis; explicitly an independent candidate.

clips.label: jump
clips.contactLabelMethod: Five-frame offline median plus measured source height/velocity hysteresis; explicitly an independent candidate.

limitations: These are three existing CMU source clips, not the full 2,548 CMU records.
No Mesh2Motion source clip has yet been recovered or measured.
Contact labels are interval estimates, not force-plate ground truth.

Zero locked drift is guaranteed by the preview's horizontal contact-anchor operation; it does not prove the original source's contact labels are all correct or that a retargeted character will have zero visible sliding.
